␛[1;38;5;254mYou␛[m
why is the round limit fatal

␛[1;38;5;254mAssistant␛[m
  Round exhaustion is fatal in Agent.runRound: the loop returns          
  ErrRoundLimit, and the chat model treats any error from a round as     
  terminal.
